attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page carries one notice for two men who have nothing to do with each other, an apostle of the Seventy and a thirteenth-century patriarch; Cleopas is a folder the corpus already keeps and is upgraded from this same page. The corpus holds forty-two patriarchs of Constantinople and no Joseph among them. `confessor` is recorded because the page's whole account of him is his resignation over the Union of Lyon and his restoration; no other rank word is on the page. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
